connections.choice.account.description: A group in the choice of connection (HI-2108): the account the connections under it are on ({account}: its name, "Personal") and its coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code").

connections.choice.label.description: Label of the choice of connection an agent runs on (Agent Settings, Add Agent, Settings → Assistant): which login or service runs it.

connections.choice.new.description: Button beside the choice of connection (Add Agent, HI-2108): opens the connection dialog to make another setup (model, effort, mode) on the chosen connection's account.

connections.choice.noneCli.defaultMessage: No {cli} account is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
connections.choice.noneCli.description: Under the choice of connection when no account of the coding agent CLI it is limited to ({cli}: "Claude Code") is on in this workspace (HI-2108). Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

connections.choice.noneHere.defaultMessage: No account is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
connections.choice.noneHere.description: Under the choice of connection when no account is on in this workspace (HI-2108). Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

connections.choice.notInstalled.description: Why a connection is greyed out in the choice of connection (HI-2108 round 1): its coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Codex") isn't installed on this PC. A short clause, lower case after the name.

connections.choice.offHere.defaultMessage: {name} (its account is off here: its CLI's first usable connection runs it)
connections.choice.offHere.description: A choice of connection that is chosen but on an account turned off in this workspace ({name}: the connection's name) (HI-2108): the agent runs on its CLI's first usable connection instead.

connections.choice.pick.description: The first choice of connection when none is chosen yet (HI-2108).

connections.choice.removed.defaultMessage: A removed connection (its CLI's first usable one runs it)
connections.choice.removed.description: A choice of connection that no longer exists (HI-2108): the agent runs on its CLI's first usable connection until another is chosen.

connections.choice.unavailable.description: A choice of connection that can't be chosen here (HI-2108), greyed out: its name ({name}) and why ({why}, a short clause).

connections.intro.add.description: The one-time accounts banner's button (HI-2108): opens Settings → Accounts & Connections.

connections.intro.dismiss.description: The one-time connections banner's button: hides it for good.

connections.intro.text.defaultMessage: Agents now run on accounts: add one for {clis} in Settings → Accounts & Connections and sign it in there. Combwork no longer uses the sign-in of your own terminal, which stays as it is.
connections.intro.text.description: A one-time banner in the main window (HI-1774; HI-2108): coding agents now each run on an account (a sign-in Hive keeps, Settings → Accounts & Connections) and none has been added yet. {clis} names the coding agent CLIs, joined ("Claude Code and Codex").

connections.mark.anotherMark.defaultMessage: Running on another connection than the one chosen
connections.mark.anotherMark.description: Accessible label of the ⟳ mark beside a running agent's connection in its row (HI-1769).

connections.mark.none.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): the workspace has no connection on for its CLI, so it can't start. Short.

connections.mark.noneUsable.defaultMessage: No {cli} account is on in this workspace: it can't start until one is (Settings → Accounts & Connections).
connections.mark.noneUsable.description: The hover of an agent's row (HI-2108): no account of its CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code") is on in this workspace. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

connections.mark.offHere.defaultMessage: {wanted} is on an account that's off in this workspace: {name}, its CLI's first usable connection, runs it
connections.mark.offHere.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-2108): its own connection ({wanted}) is on an account turned off in this workspace, so its CLI's first usable connection ({name}) runs it.

connections.mark.offNoDefault.description: An agent's row, in place of its connection (HI-1769): its own connection ({wanted}) is off in this workspace and no other is on to run it. Short.

connections.mark.offNoDefaultUsable.defaultMessage: {wanted} is off in this workspace, and no other {cli} account is on: it can't start until one is (Settings → Accounts & Connections).
connections.mark.offNoDefaultUsable.description: The hover of an agent's row (HI-2108): its own connection ({wanted}) is on an account off here and no other account of its CLI ({cli}) is on in this workspace. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

connections.mark.other.defaultMessage: Runs on {running} until it restarts. Chosen now: {chosen}
connections.mark.other.description: The hover of a running agent's connection in its row (HI-1769, shown with a ⟳ mark): its run is on one connection ({running}) and the one it would start on now is another ({chosen}: a connection's name, or why none can run it). It keeps the one it runs on until it restarts.

connections.mark.own.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-1769): the connection ({name}) was chosen for it in its Agent Settings.

connections.mark.removed.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for it was removed: {name}, its CLI's first usable connection, runs it until you choose another in its Agent Settings
connections.mark.removed.description: The hover of an agent's connection in its row (HI-2108): its connection was removed, so its CLI's first usable connection ({name}) runs it. Agent Settings names a dialog.
